About GlobixTech

Empowering Bangladesh businesses with smart software solutions since 2020

Who We Are

Innovating for a Digital Future

GlobixTech is a dynamic technology solutions provider established in 2020 with a clearly defined vision: to empower businesses through innovation and digital transformation. We specialize in delivering comprehensive IT services tailored to meet the unique challenges of modern enterprises.

We combine creativity, technical expertise, and deep industry knowledge to build impactful solutions. Whether you are a startup looking to establish a strong online presence or a large organization seeking to optimize operations, we are here to help you succeed.

Bridging Technology & Business

From Our Founder

Message from Our Founder

Nasir Uddin

Founder & Managing Director

GlobixTech Solutions

"Every great company starts with a simple idea: to solve a real problem. GlobixTech was born from my passion to make technology accessible and affordable for every business in Bangladesh."

When I founded GlobixTech in 2020, I had a clear vision: to bridge the technology gap for businesses across Bangladesh. Having witnessed firsthand the challenges that local businesses face in adopting modern software solutions, I knew there was a better way.

Too often, businesses were forced to choose between expensive international solutions that didn't fit their needs, or settling for inadequate alternatives. I believed that Bangladeshi businesses deserved world-class technology that understood their unique requirements and budget constraints.

Starting from a small office with just a handful of passionate developers, we've grown into a trusted technology partner for hundreds of businesses. But our core mission remains unchanged: to deliver innovative, affordable, and reliable software solutions that truly make a difference.

What drives me every day is seeing our clients succeed. When a school streamlines their operations with our SMS, when an e-commerce business grows with our platform, or when a company transforms their workflow with our custom solutions – that's when I know we're fulfilling our purpose.

We've built GlobixTech on three fundamental principles: understanding our clients' needs deeply, delivering exceptional quality consistently, and maintaining integrity in every interaction. These aren't just words on a wall – they're the foundation of every decision we make.

As we continue to grow and evolve, I'm incredibly proud of the team we've assembled and the culture we've created. Every member of GlobixTech shares the same passion for excellence and commitment to our clients' success.

Thank you for being part of our journey. Together, we're not just building software – we're building the digital future of Bangladesh, one solution at a time.

Nasir Uddin

Founder & Managing Director

From Our Leadership

Message from Our CEO

Syed Mominul Islam

CEO

GlobixTech Solutions

"At GlobixTech, we believe technology should empower businesses, not complicate them. Our mission is to deliver smart, affordable software solutions that help Bangladesh businesses grow and compete globally."

Since our founding in 2020, we've been committed to understanding the unique challenges faced by local businesses and creating solutions that truly work. From small startups to large enterprises, we've helped hundreds of companies transform their operations through technology.

In today's digital age, businesses need more than just software – they need a technology partner who understands their industry, their challenges, and their goals. That's exactly what we strive to be. Every solution we build is designed with the end-user in mind, ensuring it's not just powerful, but also intuitive and easy to use.

Our team of dedicated developers, designers, and support staff work tirelessly to ensure every solution we deliver exceeds expectations. We invest heavily in research and development, staying ahead of technology trends so our clients always have access to the latest innovations.

What sets us apart is our commitment to affordability without compromising quality. We believe that cutting-edge technology should be accessible to businesses of all sizes. Whether you're a small shop or a large corporation, you deserve the same level of excellence and support.

As we continue to grow, our commitment remains unchanged: to be Bangladesh's most trusted technology partner, delivering innovation with integrity. We're not just building software – we're building the future of Bangladesh's digital economy, one business at a time.

Thank you for choosing GlobixTech. Together, let's build something extraordinary.

Syed Mominul Islam

CEO, GlobixTech
